authored.title: أؤمن / أعتقد
authored.explanation_ar: نستخدم believe للتعبير عن اعتقاد أو قناعة، وقد يكون أرسخ من I think بحسب السياق.
authored.explanation_en: Use I believe to express a belief or conviction. It can sound stronger than I think.
authored.contrast_ar: I believe we can succeed قناعة؛ I think we can succeed رأي أو تقدير.
authored.contrast_en: Believe introduces a belief or judgment; that can often be omitted before the clause. It can express conviction, but the word alone is not evidence that a claim is true.

authored.form: I prefer + noun or verb ending in ing + to + alternative
authored.title: أفضل
authored.explanation_ar: نستخدم prefer للمقارنة بين اختيارين، وقد يأتي بعده اسم أو فعل بصيغة ing مع to للمقارنة.
authored.explanation_en: Use prefer to express your choice between alternatives, often with to before the second choice.
authored.contrast_ar: I prefer tea to coffee اختيار مفضل؛ I'd rather drink tea تفضيل لفعل بصيغة مختلفة.
authored.contrast_en: Use to between the alternatives in prefer A to B. Keep compared activities parallel: prefer walking to driving, not prefer walking to drive in this pattern.
